approval.note: User explicitly approved Camp Master character/environment and this 15-pose storyboard before production.

registration.coordinates: All rectangles, anchors and visibleBounds use absolute source-image coordinates. Visible bounds are exclusive alpha>32 rectangles.
registration.grid: Nominal equal square cells are 323.6667x324; integer source crops round column boundaries to 0,324,647,971 and row boundaries to multiples of324. The middle column is323px wide, others324px. Zero visible pixels touch any cell edge.
registration.bodyScale: bodyHeight is a calibration for a single common standing body scale, NOT the changing full painted bounding box. All original-size poses use210 source px. Frame7 (zero based lunge thrust) was uniformly reduced for a complete weapon margin; its bodyHeight160 compensates that exact pose so it does not shrink in-game. Never normalize to frame/cell height or weapon bbox; retain crouches/raised arms.
registration.anchors: Measured center of both lowest visible sole spans (bottom6 source rows) and bottom visible sole row. Use per-frame anchorY to prevent floating during stationary action sequences.
